categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes only touch a standalone Rust developer tool in contrib/devtools and its README, not the build system or CI.
categories.rationale: Does not affect CMake, depends, Guix, or CI configuration.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Has the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/devtools/deterministic-fuzz-coverage.
categories.rationale: Adds a mode flag to deterministic-fuzz-coverage allowing developers to run individual checks or combined corpus runs separately. As the author notes, this 'makes it easier to distinguish per-input nondeterminism from cross-input state leakage', providing worthwhile utility for fuzz test debugging.
